meaning:
§ Ar = "a city"
a city of Moab located south of the Arnon river; perhaps the capital

elsewhere.note: the slope of the valleys that incline toward the dwelling of Ar, leans on the border of Moab.”
Yahweh said to me, “Don’t bother Moab, neither contend with them in battle; for I will not give you any of his land for a possession, because I have given Ar…
The burden of Moab. For in a night, Ar of Moab is laid waste, and brought to nothing. For in a night Kir of Moab is laid waste, and brought to nothing.
